Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. This bail application has been filed on behalf of the abovenamed petitioner with prayer to release on bail in connection with POCSO Case No.83 of 2023 arising out of Ratu P.S. Case No.283 of 2022 registered under Sections 366-A/376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act pending in the court of learned Additional Judicial Commissioner-IV-cum-Special Judge POCSO, Ranchi.

3. As per allegations made in the F.I.R. which was lodged by the victim herself, her neighbour Radhika Keshari @ Lali Aunty used to talk with one boy over the phone and she has introduced her with that boy.
She also used to talk with that boy over the phone of Lali.
On 23rd August, 2022 that boy came to her house and enticed away her with him.
He took her to the house of his relative at Gumla where she lived for three days and he also established physical relation there with her.
On 26th August, 2022, he brought her to Ranchi and on the pretext to withdraw money from ATM he fled away, ultimately, she came to her house and this F.I.R. was lodged.
4. Though in F.I.R. the age of victim is shown 17 years, yet as per school certificate her age is also 17 years but the said certificate is not made part of the case dairy by the I.O.
Further the victim in her Silendar Manjhi @ Sandeep Aged About 24 ... vs The State Of Jharkhand .... ....

1 statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has also stated that she is not literate.
The victim was medically examined in which her age was determined 18-19 years.

The victim was familiar with the petitioner prior to the date when she was enticed away by the petitioner and she remained with the petitioner at several places and also went one place to another but not raised alarm.

5. In view of the submissions made and materials on record, the bail application of the petitioner is,
hereby, allowed.

Let the petitioner be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned in aforesaid case.

(Subhash Chand, J.) Rohit Silendar Manjhi @ Sandeep Aged About 24 ... vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... Opp. ... on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160924725/
